# Two newsletter contracts: source preservation and owner handoff

The original rich newsletter backend is restored through its existing canonical owners alongside Q's saved-version staging. The contracts retain separate IDs, state machines and receipts. The source overlay is 76 paths: 58 exact original files and 18 additive integrations into current schema, module, member, credential, notification, sender, package and lock owners. No new replacement service/store or identity bridge is introduced.

Frozen application source is `a247f7a02a9b94d95e9ee5a516b396202aea994b`, tree `b87c85a0fc0ae57f876b86a8018a953adbddb71c`. Initial author evidence is `7659366f6c8353abe91aae302375d7b6553043e4`; the final author packet is `509e560e1d3b528ff84b63915f235a8a124febcc`, tree `ee5cca9c408e023d41f29a11f642d9280e2658b7`, with 55 packet and 76 source bindings. The publication stacks on [PR2422](https://github.com/neo-capiro/capirov2/pull/2422), `bcad60272fa300383f117f3a08a554e9e070e85b`, tree `ffba314bf5fceda49e8178c4813bd69b3d97cd60`, and preserves all four runtime draft ancestors. Source-neutral receipt merges do not change the frozen newsletter blobs. SOURCE-MANIFEST.json binds each source path, Git blob/mode and SHA256.

| Contract                 | Source and identity                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Existing destination and behavior                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Original rich newsletter | Authored `WsNewsletterDocument` revision produces an author-owned `WsNewsletterStage` UUID under `/workspace-api/newsletters`. Declared production C `1e99f0921b207318c6d2abf03927b5c4daa5768b` and W `193703e34f2bedbb69d87d6a8ee303f65ab8dbda` agree on all 58 restored files.              | `/api/engagement/newsletters` opens/reuses legacy Outreach records and imports rich draft versions through the trusted existing draft owner. Original rich HTML, recipient capabilities, review invitations, account requests and durable delivery receipts retain their own contracts.                          |
| Q saved version          | `GET /workspace-api/drafts/:draftId/versions/:versionId/outreach-revision` reads an exact immutable `WsDocVersion` snapshot/hash. `POST /api/engagement/outreach-v3/sessions/:sessionId/newsletter-staging` retains strict `{requestId,draftId,versionId,snapshotHash,expectedStateVersion}`. | An authorized caller-selected existing OutreachV3 session receives plaintext staging through its current commands and durable receipt. Staging does not send, generate content or create a replacement session. All Q controller, reader, engine, helper, schema-immutability and test source remains unchanged. |

The legacy stage UUID never satisfies `versionId`. There is no discriminator, redirect, alias, association table, automatic migration or UUID conversion between these rows. Rich staging and saved-version staging remain independently usable source contracts.

## Canonical integration and overlap matrix

| Owner/surface                        | Additive preservation                                                                                                                                           | Existing Q behavior retained                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Original runtime/spec/SQL owners     | 25 runtime modules, 19 specs and 14 historical SQL files restored byte-exact from C/W.                                                                          | The rest of the current tree is retained; SQL/migrations are source only and never executed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Current schema owners                | Five Core and 11 Workspace newsletter model blocks, two legacy draft-format fields, two Workspace notification enum values and newsletterId.                    | Current saved-version models/immutability, prospect fields/indexes, relations and all preexisting model declarations remain.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| OutreachDraftService                 | Original trusted `importNewsletterVersion` through the existing owner.                                                                                          | Current generic edit/import/generation, auditing and format-reset authority remain; no caller-controlled trusted generic format.                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| OutreachSendIntentService            | Original server-authored newsletter tuple classifier, rich HTML preservation, source/suppression checks and individual late-use delivery gate.                  | Current sender/dispatch/outcome/receipt controls and both `prospectId:null` attachment predicates remain. Normal ordinary outreach behavior is retained.                                                                                                                                                                          |
| NotificationsService                 | Original newsletter producers, kinds and newsletterId persistence.                                                                                              | Complete current read/mark bodies are byte-exact; prospect visibility remains at five call sites plus its import.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| HillDaySourceService                 | Three original current active-member newsletter APIs.                                                                                                           | Existing member/client/wall authority remains; no live membership or ACL change.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| AiCredentialService                  | Original newsletter-specific image/text facades and helper through the current canonical owner.                                                                 | Every old member/private Anthropic query is byte-exact except the declared added constructor settings. Existing scopes and credential guards remain. No runtime credential operation occurs.                                                                                                                                      |
| Module/config/runtime owners         | Original providers/controllers/module registrations, bounded public capability paths and false-default email flags.                                             | All current DI entries and policy metadata remain. Disabled workers still construct clients/check config before enable checks; validation never bootstraps them.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Shared exports and dependency source | Five exact original shared modules and two newsletter subpath mappings; original Workspace package/lock closure.                                                | Whole shared barrel and every Q export, root alias/CI step and Workspace `test:coverage` remain. All existing lock versions/integrities/importers are retained; the sole existing snapshot marker change removes `optional:true` from `@img/colour@1.1.0` because restored original Sharp dependency makes that closure required. |
| Frontend owner                       | Concrete backend delta and original source/assets inventory are published in the preserved plan.                                                                | Frozen frontend `4a1614886fd98bb42d529f1ef59b3d01d7ff9173`, tree `16c0b62901859aa4ff3f2ea01856aa13e13c65cd`, remains untouched. Consumption requires coordinated preservation/porting of the original rich UI and assets.                                                                                                         |
| Scoped EngagementService reporting   | Existing published public method signatures suffice for this source composition; module/provider additions must compose with that owner's eventual publication. | Task `task01a12dc9-21a3-7062-908e-b6fabc37c027` retains its reviewed unpublished implementation and branches. No reporting body, branch or source was changed or claimed lost. Header identity does not establish behavior of the unpublished implementation.                                                                     |

Public recipient capability access retains the original 64-hex token, bound draft version and non-test delivery eligibility in pending/sending/sent/unknown. Eligibility does not prove completed send. Review GET can activate a saved reviewer invitation/grant and notify; Workspace performs no Clerk/user/tenant-membership writes there. Account-status paths can read providers or persist invitation/status receipts. These paths are not universally read-only. The source review must use refusing/fake collaborators, without actual GETs, worker/provider constructors or customer state. Current nonempty groups are rejected by the original normalizer before artifacts; original empty-array duplicate-key behavior and dormant group branches remain. No broad group repair or historical-row assumption is introduced.

## Evidence, acceptance and remaining limits

Author qualification passes 706 static preservation checks, 67 inert owner-seam cases, original dependency closure and cached full Core source typing (exit zero). Cached official Prisma 5.22 WASM schema/DMMF parsing and engine-free JS/declaration generation pass with a sanitized launcher containing only PATH and an isolated XDG_CACHE_HOME; the official generator fork additionally sets its controlled PRISMA_GENERATOR_INVOCATION marker. Datasource URL values are empty, output/cache directories are owned locally and no native engine artifacts are emitted. No native CLI, download, package installation, client instantiation, database or SQL execution occurred. These checks do not establish native PostgreSQL/RLS, migration, runtime or deployment acceptance.

Independent source/schema/dependency acceptance is `82f3f6067cb468c6afb4ec710cd9cc08a592aacf`, tree `b2664ede2b714c420a56896a5e9e91eeb76c6f15`, accepting exact frozen source a247. It passes 679 source/schema/lock and 21 generation/import checks, refuses eight lock and ten schema/import mutations, binds 68 relative imports and verifies 38 emitted file hashes. The original 58-file set matches the preserved plan, and all 131 final author source/packet entries verify. Its 75 indexed review files retain the initial reader/receipt assumptions and raw failures; no application, generator, client, provider or SQL execution occurred in that review.

Independent authorization/replay acceptance is `6713a190fdb5b9a8495d9cd1ada80d80ab6fe1f1`, tree `09dc34f186eda085d584a90a748bb599a0e376aa`, accepting the same frozen source. It passes 69 before/after comparisons: 44 authority/version/token/GET/rich-send replay, 17 account attempt/status and eight individual sender gate comparisons; six classifier refusals and eight public-prefix controls also pass. Current role/wall/cancellation/expiry, revision CAS, confirmed preference/survey writes, terminal unknown no-repost, lease/overlap refusals and final-response withholding match original C. Two simultaneous account calls use a serialized synthetic transaction scheduler, not native MVCC. Complete Q sender bodies match after only the declared inverse C additions, including both prospect attachment predicates. All five initial reviewer harness failures remain in its 46 indexed evidence files. No actual route, GET, provider/client constructor, SQL, timer or database was invoked.

The exact `htmlparser2@8.0.2` package is absent from the cache. Workspace source typing initially failed on that package and host/cache resolution of auth/pdfkit/zod; host-only corrections clear the other errors, leaving six diagnostics for the missing parser and its callback types. Raw results and isolated host corrections remain in the author packet. No newer parser is silently substituted, installed or accepted as the production dependency. Both independent receipts accept the bounded source work while explicitly leaving full Workspace/parser/native acceptance open.

The composed parse-only inspection passes five ownership profiles over 2,219 production source files and the seven-helper inventory. Twenty restored production modules enter those configured roots; the original shared modules and specs have their separately bound source identities. The four runtime application/control blobs are unchanged. The independent PR2422 publication continuity receipt `675a6341920fea2f87cf5c556d2e682401bc8e73` verifies its 157 committed master entries and all 713 entries in 16 inherited indices; that receipt is an actual source-neutral ancestor here. All failed and passing evidence, including source/lock reader mistakes and verbatim patch whitespace warnings, remains preserved.

The final read-only Git proof verifies zero non-document drift from frozen a247 and exactly 76 source paths beyond PR2422. All 21,862 baseline paths outside the overlay are exact, including 10,183 documentation paths. Of 603 baseline schema/migration paths, 601 are exact and only the two declared schemas receive additive source changes. Fourteen exact historical migration sources are added. The proof reads protected reporting blob identities without reading implementation bodies; no operational acceptance follows from these metadata checks.

The frontend ownership inputs are [BACKEND-CONTRACT-DELTA.md](../cleanup-newsletter-two-contract-preservation-plan-20261012/BACKEND-CONTRACT-DELTA.md), [FRONTEND-BOUNDARY.md](../cleanup-newsletter-two-contract-preservation-plan-20261012/FRONTEND-BOUNDARY.md) and [OWNERSHIP-MATRIX.md](../cleanup-newsletter-two-contract-preservation-plan-20261012/OWNERSHIP-MATRIX.md). Forty-three original runtime paths and 179 static asset blobs are absent by identity from the frozen dedicated frontend. Its owner must preserve/port those alongside the new saved-version flow before claiming complete rich-builder recovery. This is source non-equivalence, not a claim about deployed asset serving. No frontend port, abandoned monolith UI restoration or live rich-builder acceptance is included here.

All eleven native/full gaps, 123 deferred clock/RNG samples, unchanged historical baseline failures, Memory3 manual-command failure and operator-manifest provenance gap remain open. Quick log Commitment/We owe/They owe/counterparty UI is excluded; existing shared task/backend source remains. Main merging, deployment, real messages/uploads/providers/models/customer/credential/permission actions, AWS, database/migrations/native execution and security/network changes remain excluded. Original and new candidate heads and every failed/passing receipt are preserved.

# Exact additive backend contract and owner seams

Q's saved-revision API stays unchanged: `GET /workspace-api/drafts/:draftId/versions/:versionId/outreach-revision`; strict `POST /api/engagement/outreach-v3/sessions/:sessionId/newsletter-staging {requestId,draftId,versionId,snapshotHash,expectedStateVersion}`. The old C stage UUID never satisfies or becomes an alias of versionId. No new input discriminator, redirect or association table is proposed.

The original rich contract is additive under its original separate paths. The independently re-bound67-route inventory in `evidence/source-dependency-receipt.json` carries every original controller/decorator/DTO delegation body through the pinned assessment source. Its private Workspace prefix is `/workspace-api/newsletters`; `POST documents/:id/stage {revision}` returns a private author-owned stage UUID plus `/engagement/outreach?newsletterStage=...`. Core private prefix `/api/engagement/newsletters` has stage/get/open/prepare/send/test. Open creates/reuses a legacy OutreachRecord, not a V3 session. Preserve original status/conflict/error/DTO/role/runtime-action semantics.

Recipient-only Core prefix `/api/engagement/newsletter-public/:token` serves archive, unsubscribe/preferences and survey capability routes. Asset-only Workspace `/workspace-api/newsletters/assets/file/:token` serves validated retained Bytes/MIME. Their original public auth routing and response headers must be reconciled together in source with private routes; this plan does not grant/change runtime network, credentials or permissions. Preserve the distinct exact public prefix, never authoring-wide auth bypass. GET preference/survey presents; confirmed POST mutates. Public capability access requires64hex token, a bound draftVersion and a non-test delivery in pending/sending/sent/unknown, which proves eligibility rather than completed send. Public asset lookup deliberately ignores deletedAt.

Shared package retains every Q export and adds C's exact `typesVersions.newsletter`, `typesVersions.newsletter-render`, `exports['./newsletter']`, `exports['./newsletter-render']` mappings to dist declarations and require/import/default JS. Five original shared module blobs stay attributable. C's root index has no newsletter re-export statement; do not invent one or wholesale copy its older273KB barrel. Existing Q `workspace-saved-revision`/Objective/prospect source exports remain intact.

| Existing canonical owner | Concrete composition | Preserve current Q behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| OutreachDraftService | Add exact trusted `importNewsletterVersion(ctx, UpsertGeneratedVersionInput & {newsletterStageId})`; retain manually_authored tuple, post-commit audit and source-owned stage query | All generic HTTP import/edit/generation ownership, auditing, generic format resets and Q source guards. No generic caller-controlled trusted format. |
| OutreachSendIntentService | Compose C server-authored `(contentFormat,newsletterStageId,generationStatus)` classifier, rich HTML preservation, queue-time source/suppression checks and individual `newsletter:` delivery late-use gate | Existing2393/current sender authority, dispatch/outcome/receipt/runtime state; both Q `prospectId:null` attachment predicates. C removes those unrelated predicates; do not copy removals. Normal ordinary outreach/groups stay unchanged. |
| HillDaySourceService | Add three exact current active-member APIs `newsletterMembers`, `newsletterMember`, `newsletterMemberByEmail` | Existing source/client/ethical-wall owner and original methods; no member creation or ACL grant. Source diff includes unrelated formatting only. |
| AiCredentialService | Preserve original newsletter image/alt facade methods through this existing owner, distinct original image/text model routing and tenant-first provider contract | Current Q canonical text credential guards, scopes and permission bodies; no broad substitution or credential-management operation. Validate a precise reviewed composition rather than copying an older owner wholesale. |
| NotificationsService | Add two newsletter kind types, newsletterId input/persistence and producer support | Q `prospectNotificationVisible` filtering for list/unread/markRead/markAllRead remains. C removed those guards; never copy those unrelated removals. Existing nullable draft/collaborator/role fields stay unchanged. |
| Current schema owners | Add11 WsNewsletter models, five Core Newsletter models; add existing WsNotification enum values/newsletterId; add existing OutreachDraftVersion contentFormat/newsletterStageId | Current WsDraft prospectId/index, WsDocVersion/model/immutability migration, all current model relations/constraints and other migrations. No Core ORM model for Q's shared source reader. |
| Module/config owners | Register exact C NewsletterModule, legacy/private/public controllers/service, account provider/service/controller, both workers/TenantAdminModule imports; preserve newsletter runtime actions and false-default email flags | Every current Q DI provider/controller/import/export and route/runtime metadata. Preserve worker constructor dependencies even while disabled; no timer/provider activation in source qualification. |
| Workspace package/lock | Add C versions htmlparser2 8.0.2, sanitize-html2.17.7, sharp0.35.5, @types/sanitize-html^2.16.1 plus exact compatible lock source closure | All current scripts including test:coverage and root focused aliases/CI. C removes test:coverage; that is unrelated. No PM install or native Sharp download/test here. |

Published interface signatures match exactly across C, Q802 and7ea: EngagementService `getOutreachRecord`, `updateOutreachRecord`, `findCampaignSendConnection`; send-intent `createIntent`; TenantAdmin `updateMemberRole`. These header comparisons show existing callable names/parameters, not return-body/type/native acceptance. No EngagementService source edit is required by the minimal import map, and no reporting implementation was reviewed. Existing draft list signature also matches; newsletter importer and membership/credential facades are the missing additive methods.

Core account invitations use saved requests/current identity, member/client/admin authority and existing Team/Clerk providers; providers may read or mutate on explicit dispatch/status. Preserve leases, request/attempt identity, bounded provider roles and terminal unknown outcomes. Review/invitation email workers are default-disabled but construct provider clients/validate config before enable checks. Preserve producers+requests+receipts+workers as one dependency chain, test only with refusing fakes. Existing account/table roles do not authorize new runtime operations.

No group bypass change belongs in this composition. Current nonempty group destinations are already rejected by the normalizer before artifacts; DTO has no groupMembers. The retained dormant group artifact branch and hypothetical historical-row classifier difference are not proof of live rows or reachable new group creation. Do not broaden the sender `group:` gate. Preserve original rows/receipt identities if independently evidenced later, under a separate compatibility assessment.

# Original UI/static identities and frozen dedicated frontend boundary

This is read-only source evidence, not a deployed asset-origin/routing or behavior finding. Original monolith C/W and frozen dedicated frontend4a are different source contracts. Parent retains frontend/retirement ownership. No Web implementation, consumption, asset serving, package, route or export edit is authorized by this packet.

Original `apps/web` paths containing newsletter form an exact262-path bounded family:43 non-test runtime TS/TSX,179 static assets,37 tests,2 CSS,1 icon-generator script. The manifest records C/W Git blob identity, C SHA256 and bytes for each. All43 runtime and179 assets are C==W;261/262 total equal. Sole different test is `NewsletterEditor.test.tsx`: C `902bbe86edd13a659b8cb231fd27425e1b36b33d`, W `a315b682643e13eb12fd9a384f87c8d16b3f0cc4`. Keep both test histories, do not claim every Web family blob equal.

The25 runtime backend graph has a renderer/static dependency:9 AST URL sites in original shared modules include fixed `/newsletter/{capitol,policy-desk,newsroom,social-update}.png`, legacy SVG→PNG rewrite, and dynamic `${publicUrl}/newsletter/social-${platform}-${settings.iconStyle}.png`. Source raw callsites/line numbers and original179 binary asset identities are retained without invoking renderers/generators. Asset-byte serving origin and complete allowed platform/style matrix need frontend/release coordination. Do not re-encode/delete/replace existing emailed asset URLs by assumption.

The local `/workspace/capiro-frontend` checkout is a different available lineage at `02c02d95bdf3949662b9123f425271c6491ffdab`, tree `776883e3f3b529650f9e9f01595bff34607d551a`;4a was absent locally. Authorized read-only GitHub source calls resolved the full frozen head `4a1614886fd98bb42d529f1ef59b3d01d7ff9173` to actual Git tree `16c0b62901859aa4ff3f2ea01856aa13e13c65cd`. The canonical tree recursion has4939 entries, truncated:false. Commitish tree response also preserved; the actual `/git/commits` tree reference and canonical `/git/trees/16c...` response establish the precise binding. No Git fetch/checkout, package install or source edit was made to frontend.

None of the262 original C family paths exists at the same path in4a. None of their C Git blobs occurs at a renamed path anywhere in the entire4939-entry frozen tree, including production apps/packages and evidence. This proves absence of those exact original source bytes in this source revision; it does not alone prove that independently authored presentation lacks every equivalent behavior. A direct `apps/web/public/newsletter` source request returned404, retained. These findings do not query deployed frontend/CDN/public hosts or establish live origin behavior.

The frozen dedicated source has9 non-test newsletter presentation/hook/model modules plus the existing `workspace-newsletter-staging.ts` operations owner. Eleven selected package/config/router/owner files were read; every fetched blob SHA matches its canonical tree entry. The source route closes `/modules/[module]` → moduleCatalog → ModuleScreen `workspace` → WorkspaceScreen → NewsletterWorkflow. The latter builds existing WorkspaceDraft/NewsletterBody blocks and selects a saved revision and existing OutreachV3 session. The dedicated NewsletterStaging explicitly previews snapshotHash and current session version and states rich formatting/images are outside that skeleton handoff. Its operation owner strictly sends the Q route/request exactly; it contains no C stage UUID input or rich-stage route alias. The preserved Q contract therefore has an existing frontend consumer, with no need for a bridge.

Frozen `apps/web/package.json` uses Next16.4.0/React19.3.0; build is next build. Next config has standalone output/tracing root, @capiro/ui transpilation and shared headers, and no newsletter asset rewrites. This identifies the dedicated build/config owner, not a successful build or externally hosted asset availability. Complete rich original UI/router/shared asset/dependency equivalence is not established by the named262 family alone. Cross-owner frontend integration remains pending behind the backend contract delta and parent path coordination. Dedicated frontend AGENTS forbids importing old UI under its default implementation policy; current explicit preservation scope and parent coordination govern any future deliberate implementation. No copy is proposed here.

Preservation handoff must keep the rich backend route and source identity separate from dedicated Q staging, explicitly select original or reviewed equivalent rich presentation ownership, preserve recipient public-link and static/public-asset origins/paths/bytes, and retain all older history. Until then, do not describe the four-source union or backend-only preservation candidate as fully composed/preserved production UI or deployment. This gap does not block the authorized additive backend source slice and requires no unspecified UUID bridge product decision.

# Finite implementation and overlap map

The packet owns only its new docs directory. The implementation author/root must reserve the source rows below together before editing. No source retirement is proposed.

Generated Prisma import is type-only and intentionally untracked; coherent schema declarations later require authorized no-engine source qualification. |

Original non-newsletter Q method bodies/guards remain. |

No source constructor or app bootstrap in tests. |

Published EngagementService3 headers only; reporting owner/branches excluded absolutely. |

Exact original C/W frontend/static manifest attached; no UI copy, route/asset serving/dependency edit by this backend task. Contract and asset release coordination precedes consumption. |

The source graph resolves original relative runtime imports to25 new owners and20 existing cross-owner files; the only unavailable relative target is generated Workspace Prisma declarations, type-only. External imports and exact C/Q/four package source versions are recorded. This is a finite direct-source prerequisite closure with explicit canonical boundaries; it is not a whole-app build/module-loader/runtime acceptance proof. Existing provider/identity/Prisma imports terminate at their established canonical owners, never a newly invented abstraction.

No change is allocated to EngagementService, reporting branches, frontend DTOs/transport, unrelated schemas/SQL, clock/RNG/public-law/migration containment, security infrastructure, deployment or customer data. Actual immutable/frontend/schema constraints and source test failures remain independently reviewable prerequisites.
